name: Nova Scotia non-resident deed transfer tax (10%)
description: Non-residents of Nova Scotia pay 10% of the higher of purchase price or assessed value on the share they acquire of residential property with three or fewer units (agreements after 31 March 2025), in addition to municipal deed transfer tax. Buyers who move to Nova Scotia within 12 months (transfers from 6 August 2026) can avoid it.

attributes.base: higher of purchase price or assessed value, on the non-resident's ownership share
attributes.property: residential property with three or fewer dwelling units, including residential vacant land
attributes.move_to_ns_exemption: declare intent at transfer and provide proof of residency within 12 months (transfers on or after 2026-08-06; 6 months before)
